prd_summary.problem: SME onboarding takes 12 working days on average; documents are requested twice and compliance sign-off is not tracked.
goals: Reduce average onboarding time from 12 to 5 working days
non_goals: Core banking integration in the first release
Customer login in the first release

epics.title: Document collection
epics.goal: Know which documents are received or missing for each application

epics.title: Compliance review
epics.goal: No account opens without a recorded KYC sign-off

epics.title: Management reporting
epics.goal: See pipeline stages and time spent per stage

stories.title: Document checklist per application
stories.want: a checklist per application showing which required documents are received and which are missing
stories.so_that: I stop asking customers twice for the same document

acceptance_criteria.given: an application with 2 of the 5 required documents uploaded
acceptance_criteria.then: the checklist shows 2 items as Received and 3 items as Missing

acceptance_criteria.given: an application with all 5 required documents uploaded
acceptance_criteria.then: the checklist shows 5 items as Received and the status reads Complete

acceptance_criteria.given: a file uploaded with no document type selected
acceptance_criteria.then: the upload is rejected with the message Select a document type

stories.evidence_quote: They want one checklist per application showing which documents are received and which are missing.

stories.title: Missing document reminder
stories.want: a reminder when a document has been missing for more than 3 working days
stories.so_that: I can chase the customer before the application stalls

acceptance_criteria.given: a document missing for 4 working days
acceptance_criteria.then: a reminder for that application and document is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: a document missing for 2 working days
acceptance_criteria.then: no reminder is shown for that document

stories.evidence_quote: RMs asked for a reminder when a document has been missing for more than 3 working days

stories.title: KYC sign-off gate
stories.want: account opening to be blocked until I have signed off the KYC review
stories.so_that: no account is opened without compliance approval

acceptance_criteria.given: an application without a KYC sign-off
acceptance_criteria.then: the action is blocked with the message KYC sign-off required

acceptance_criteria.given: an application with a KYC sign-off
acceptance_criteria.then: the application status changes to Account opened

stories.evidence_quote: no account can be opened until compliance has signed off the KYC review

stories.title: Sign-off audit record
stories.want: each sign-off to record who approved it and when
stories.so_that: every approval can be shown at audit

acceptance_criteria.then: the record shows my name and the date and time of approval

acceptance_criteria.when: any user tries to edit the approver name
acceptance_criteria.then: the edit is rejected and the original record is unchanged

stories.evidence_quote: Every sign-off must record who approved and when.

stories.title: Keep documents of rejected applications
stories.want: documents of rejected applications to be kept

acceptance_criteria.then: all 5 documents remain attached and the status reads Rejected

stories.evidence_quote: a rejected application must keep its documents for audit

stories.title: Weekly pipeline dashboard
stories.want: a weekly dashboard of applications per stage and the average days per stage
stories.so_that: I can see where onboarding is slow against the 5-day target

acceptance_criteria.then: it shows the count of applications in each of the 3 stages

acceptance_criteria.given: completed applications in the last 7 days
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows the average number of days spent in each stage

acceptance_criteria.given: no applications in the last 7 days
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows the message No applications this week

stories.evidence_quote: wants a weekly dashboard showing how many applications are in each stage and the average days per stage

open_questions.question: Is the compliance review SLA 2 or 3 working days? RMs and Compliance disagree.
Can RMs upload documents on behalf of customers from a mobile phone?

decisions.decision: The first release is for internal staff only; customers will not log in.
No core banking integration in the first release; account numbers are created manually.
